messages:
kim: Hey folks — spontaneous idea: taco truck + tiny pub-quiz in the courtyard next Friday (6/27) at 6:30pm? Food truck does tacos and elote, quiz is ~30 mins, prizes = bragging rights + stickers. Too chaotic?
nolan: Love tacos. I'm in. Can we do a non-alcoholic option for drinks too?
ash: In if tacos are involved. Can volunteer to run the quiz  short rounds, mixture of music/tech/general.
viv: I can bring a battery speaker and a whiteboard for scores. Also allergic to cilantro fyi.
leo: Count me in for setup  can help with chairs and tables. :chair:
kim: Awesome. Quick venue poll: courtyard or rooftop? React :courtyard: for courtyard, :rooftop: for roof. (If rainy fallback to Annex on ground floor).
nolan: :courtyard:
ash: :rooftop: (rooftop vibes)
viv: :courtyard: (proximity to the kitchen is nice)
leo: :courtyard:
kim: Courtyard wins 3-1 so provisional plan there. Food prefs: reply with emoji — :taco: = regular, :green_salad: = veggie, :no_entry_sign: = gluten-free request.
nolan: :taco:
ash: :taco:
viv: :green_salad:
leo: :no_entry_sign: (gluten sensitive)
kim: Perfect. Quiz format: 4 rounds x 5 questions, quick-fire final buzzer. Any category requests?
nash: Music + weird history pls. I'll weave in a bonus audio round.
viv: Pop culture and one "what happened at Redwood" dumb question.
nolan: Weird food facts category pls  I will bring a ridiculous hat as prize. :tophat:
kim: Love the hat prize. Events-bot, can you make a calendar event and set an RSVP link? Also set a reminder 2 hours prior for setup crew.
events-bot: Event created: "Taco Truck & Tiny Pub-Quiz"  Fri Jun 27  6:30 PM  Courtyard  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/qw123 (reminder 2 hours prior)
leo: I'll bring extra folding chairs and a small power strip for speaker.
nolan: I'll bring non-alcoholic drinks and napkins.
kim: If rain, fallback is Annex; I'll post final confirmation by Thu 6/26 5pm. Please RSVP on the calendar link so I can tell the truck how many tacos.
viv: RSVP'd. Can't wait. :taco: :tada:
